4428.title: Plugin credentials enter provider diagnostic events
4428.rootCauseOneLine: The environment resolver masks core contributions only; plugin values are emitted verbatim and the server serializes those entries into stored events.

prReviews.topFinding: Previous stored plaintext remains; no PR branch code was executed.

4428.proposedFix: Redact diagnostic values while preserving provider environment delivery; handle historical stored entries separately. Existing linked PR 4434 prevents a duplicate automated fix.
4428.caveats: Two clean synthetic runtime reproductions; persistence and CLI propagation inspected statically. Private installation data was not read. Full reproduction test is inline because the reports repository forbids committed test artifacts.
